definitions.explanation: The act of combining various elements into a unified whole, or an adjective-like use meaning comprehensive or all-encompassing.

examples.japanese: {総合|そうごう}{的|てき}に{判断|はんだん}する。
{総合|そうごう}{病院|びょういん}で{検査|けんさ}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: I had an examination at a general hospital.

examples.japanese: すべての{意見|いけん}を{総合|そうごう}して、{最終|さいしゅう}{的|てき}な{結論|けつろん}を{出|だ}した。
examples.english: We synthesized all opinions and reached a final conclusion.

notes:
USAGE:
Very commonly used as a prefix meaning "comprehensive" or "general" in compound words. Often paired with {的|てき} to form the adjectival expression {総合|そうごう}{的|てき} (comprehensive, overall).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {総合|そうごう}{病院|びょういん} (general hospital)
- {総合|そうごう}{大学|だいがく} (comprehensive university)
- {総合|そうごう}{的|てき}に (comprehensively, overall)
- {総合|そうごう}{評価|ひょうか} (overall evaluation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {統合|とうごう}: integration — bringing separate things into one system, whereas {総合|そうごう} emphasizes bringing together diverse elements for an overall view
